<div class="project-card">
<h3>Capstone Agent Studio</h3>
<p>A rule-aware, evaluation-driven AI agent for turning a vague capstone idea into a complete, testable, documented project package. The repository emphasizes deterministic tools, security checks, evaluation, and reproducibility.</p>
<p><a class="pub-btn pub-btn-primary" href="https://github.com/akabgani/capstone-agent-studio" target="_blank">GitHub</a></p>

<div class="project-card">
<h3>HiFBA</h3>
<p>Implementation associated with high-order inexact forward-backward methods and boosted variants for nonsmooth and nonconvex optimization.</p>
<p><a class="pub-btn pub-btn-primary" href="https://github.com/akabgani/HiFBA" target="_blank">GitHub</a>
<a class="pub-btn" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22231" target="_blank">Paper</a></p>
</div>

<div class="project-card">
<h3>Inexact RPL</h3>
<p>Research code for residual Polyak–Łojasiewicz analysis and inexact proximal-gradient experiments.</p>
<p><a class="pub-btn pub-btn-primary" href="https://github.com/akabgani/inexact_RPL" target="_blank">GitHub</a></p>
</div>

<div class="project-card">
<h3>HiMARS Recommender System</h3>
